profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech | Frontend | React | Typescript | GraphQL
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience delivering scalable, user-centric applications across fintech, enterprise, and cloud platforms. Skilled in modern frontend technologies (React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js) and backed by deep expertise in test automation and CI/CD pipelines.

At Intuit and PayPal, I accelerated feature delivery, improved maintainability by 40%, and drove 90% test automation coverage—empowering faster releases with higher reliability. I bring a unique dual perspective as both a front-end developer and Quality Engineer, enabling me to build performant UIs while ensuring long-term stability.

After a purposeful career pause for caregiving, I’ve re-entered the workforce with renewed energy, continuously upskilling through certifications (Meta Front-End Developer, Mastering TypeScript) and advanced DSA training. Passionate about crafting seamless user experiences, optimizing performance, and contributing to high-growth, customer-focused environments.
